name: Factory work-routine motion study
status: audition, not an approved final edit

opening.purpose: Establish an ordinary, tiring workplace; no robots or narration.
One small lever stroke, industrial response, then reset.
Time passes slowly; four deliberate clock ticks.
Return to the same task; the work continues.

robot.placement: separate later-coverage study; excluded from opening

final_edit_direction: No robots at the chapter beginning; sparse appearances until the last two thirds, ramping toward the end. Exact reveal time remains open.
limits: The worker wide is a held photograph, not a completed body performance.
The lever insert uses one rigid photographic hand/forearm/lever layer; it does not test elbow articulation.
The robot tests a small planar head tilt, not a three-dimensional turn.
Machinery and clock sound are original local synthesis pending listening review.
